status: PRE-REGISTERED confirmatory run of docs/13 amendment A3, hypothesis H8.8 part (c) (end-to-end fit throughput on the V100), full training split, under the EXCLUSIVE GPU lock. No evaluation split is scored.

rerun_of.why: stopped by this job (SIGTERM to its own process, exit 143) at 15:29 UTC before any fit started: it held the EXCLUSIVE GPU lock while its memory rule waited (memory.current 59.5 GiB, of which about 51 GiB page cache of other jobs' files; working set 17.1 GiB; + 24 GiB >= 0.80 x 96 GiB), blocking every other GPU job. No measurement was made; the directory is kept as a record (protocol rule 9).
rerun_of.same_as: experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_a3_H8_8c.json: identical protocol, repeats, threshold and checks; only compute.peak_gib changes (see compute.peak_note)

docs: docs/11 sections 11.2 to 11.7; docs/12 F19 and F20 (b) residues, (c) pooled EM, (d) pruning estimator; docs/13 amendment A3
seeds: none: the CVTM-core is deterministic given the data (docs/13 A3); uncertainty is the document-block bootstrap

data.byte_accounting: total negative log2-likelihood of the validation subword stream / UTF-8 bytes of the validation text (1,145,547), protocol CP
data.dataset_hashes: protocol.write_dataset_hashes(('train', 'validation')): tok and doc_start of both splits, validation text and doc_bytes, as results/20260923T042350Z_CP_anchor/dataset_hashes.json plus the document boundaries

frozen.note: the frozen CVTM-core of lane L0 (docs/11 11.6 on the full V 8000 train split, whole-document window, components S, D0..D4, P); the stage-1 files must still carry these sha256 (checked at start)

bootstrap.statistic: per resample: sum of bits / sum of UTF-8 bytes of the drawn documents (paired: of the differences)
bootstrap.label: derived

decisions_before_the_run.end_to_end_fit: the wall time of CVTMCore.fit on the full split with the tokens already in host memory: KN-5 without H (GPU), its suffix clauses, ln P and k* on H, document clauses of H and the MAP-EM, KN-5 on all documents (GPU), its suffix clauses; this is the whole docs/11 11.6 protocol from tokens to the frozen model
decisions_before_the_run.throughput: training tokens of the split (135,246,414) / fit wall time; the tokens are counted once although two KN fits pass over them
decisions_before_the_run.repeats: 5 repeats in one process (docs/13 section 5: median of at least 5 repeats under the exclusive lock, min to max range); the first repeat includes the CUDA context start and is counted; every repeat must reproduce the frozen state hash
decisions_before_the_run.data_load: the load and re-hash of the stores is timed once and reported separately (and as a derived throughput including it)
decisions_before_the_run.label: exclusive GPU lock; the host CPU is shared (other container processes and host tenants), the CPU of other container processes is logged per repeat

hypothesis: (c) end-to-end fit throughput on the V100

thresholds.text: (c) at least 1M training tokens per second (docs/13 A3 H8.8)

compute.gpu_pool_note: the same CuPy pool cap as the frozen fit of L0 (its peak pool was 7.3 GB, the cap does not bind)
compute.peak_note: 16 GiB = measured peak RSS of a driver process of this lane that ran the same full-split CVTMCore.fit, 12.50 GiB (VmHWM, results/20260924T150704Z_cvtm_a3_H8_8a/, fits at 5M, 20M, 67M and the full split plus validation scoring), and 11.12 GiB for loading the frozen core and scoring validation (results/20260924T102203Z_cvtm_a3_H8_2/, results/20260924T102454Z_cvtm_a3_H8_7/), plus a margin of about 3.5 GiB. The earlier 24 GiB was an estimate from the L0 cache build, whose driver also held the cache-writing callbacks. The memory rule itself is unchanged (memory.current + peak < 0.80 memory.max, poll every 2 minutes); memory.current counts page cache of other jobs' files (about 51 GiB of the 60 GiB at 15:28 UTC), so the 24 GiB bound kept a run waiting inside the exclusive GPU lock.
compute.memory_rule: before each repeat: memory.current + 16 GiB < 0.80 memory.max, else wait (poll 2 minutes); the same check is made OUTSIDE the lock before launching, so that the run does not queue for the exclusive lock while the rule already fails; mem_guard at its default limit
